cnn.loss: masked Huber delta1 divided by training observed endpoint fraction
cnn.epoch_selection: mean of six endpoint losses, each pooled over the five inner validation folds; earliest tie
cnn.normalization: training-original P0 band means/SD and training-observed target means/SD; population SD
cnn.seed_derivation: seed_for from archived code; SHA256 of | joined (42,parts), first4 bytes little endian modulo2**31-1
cnn.attention: 48->16->1 tanh, final layer zero initialized, softmax(score+log(pixel_fraction))

ridge_selection: pooled observed inner grab RMSE, strongest alpha on exact ties
uncertainty_arm: Separate fixed160epoch and alpha1000, inner5 calibration; not the selected main models
packaging_validation: No training, inference, new model selection or statistical resampling in this release task
